releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
- Added support for the ending of Symbiosis if the Symbiosis Ship Logs addon is installed (thanks GameWyrm!)
- The plaques describing each mod will now say what mod they are referring to if it is not installed.
- Placed a recipe for soup on a table instead of the floor

releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
- Added support for the ending of Band Together now that it is fully playable.
- Updated the preview image used for Magistarium.

releases.name: Version 1.0.0
releases.body:
The jam has now been judged!
- Ping now has dialogue specific to each jam entry
- Talking to Ping after completing a jam entry will reveal new objects around the Starship Community
- The downstairs whiteboards now list the winners
- Upstairs now has short preview text for each entry

Congrats to all entrants! Symbiosis and Band Together currently lack extra content here but it will be added once they are complete.

releases.name: Version 0.5.6
